CustomField.description: Last day of proposed coverage, calculated from the Quote proposed start date and contract term. Blank when the start or a positive term is missing.
CustomField.formula: IF( OR(ISBLANK(Proposed_Start_Date__c), ISBLANK(Proposed_Term_months__c), Proposed_Term_months__c <= 0), NULL, ADDMONTHS(Proposed_Start_Date__c, Proposed_Term_months__c) - 1 )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Last day of proposed coverage, calculated from the Quote proposed start date and contract term. Blank when the start or a positive term is missing.
CustomField.label: Proposed End Date
